How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIFTEM Young Professional - Admin Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIFTEM Young Professional – Admin recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIFTEM Young Professional – Admin position is 06 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional – Admin post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be Any Graduate, preferably with an MBA (Regular) or Post-Graduation in any discipline to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional – Admin post is 32 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional – Admin position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIFTEM Young Professional – Admin job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional – Admin role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional – Admin is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIFTEM located?
faq.answer: NIFTEM is located in Kundli, Haryana, with the pincode 131028.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional – Admin post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Young Professional – Admin post in this recruitment drive.
